title: records-of-truth-carry-one-extension-artifact
intention: Every record of truth carries one extension, .artifact, so that 'is this a record?' is answerable from the filename alone and the jurisdiction, the PreToolUse gate and the commit question each collapse to one rule instead of a list of directories and basenames.
why: Law 1 (one spelling of the record set instead of a directory list re-derived by three readers), Law 4 (the deny rule becomes one line of physics — Akien: 'then we only disallow one extension'), Law 6 (the door stays the one gate; the rename is its first bulk write and proves it under load)
how: Re-cast 2026-11-13 into children, one per reader group, with the outside-readers census as child 1 (46851816800f, read-only, the only child built now). The moving children stay at TICKETME until the orchestrator calls a quiet window across all boxes. Each re-measures its group's readers first, then rewrites them to read both extensions behind a flag. Then the bulk rename runs through `cairn artifact rename` in that window, one journaled act per repo committed under the hook. Last, jurisdiction.json and bin/cmd/artifactgate collapse to one *.artifact rule and the flag is removed.

clauses.claim: zero files under CairnCommons/{tickets,troubles,decisions,slates,ideas,questions,adjudications} end in .json, and zero state/history/intention+why/validation files under cairn end in .json (find + count, both zero)
jurisdiction.json carries one rule per root, {"name": "*.artifact"}, and locate() answers yes for every renamed file and no for the lab, node_classes and notes
both journals verify from genesis with every rename journaled (the old path's last entry absent, the new path chained from it), and `cairn artifact check` passes both roots

every reader in a fresh reader census reads .artifact: the ticket inspector, the harbor's clearance, the review queue, the session-open banner, the chart doors and the sorted/saveslate/idea doors run green on the renamed corpus
a Write/Edit/Bash redirect aimed at any *.artifact is refused at PreToolUse by one extension check

WRONG INTENT if the outside-readers census (child 1, 46851816800f) finds a code reader outside our repos that needs .json: then the extension carries information and the rule is a directory rule, and this ticket routes back before any file moves

traces_to: Law 1 (one spelling of the record set instead of a directory list re-derived by three readers), Law 4 (the deny rule becomes one line of physics — Akien: 'then we only disallow one extension'), Law 6 (the door stays the one gate; the rename is its first bulk write and proves it under load)

decisions.text: D1: child 1 (46851816800f) builds the outside-readers census, read-only, and its finding is recorded on this ticket's log before any child moves a file.

D2: the moving children (four reader groups, the bulk rename, the rule collapse) stay at TICKETME until the orchestrator calls a quiet window across all boxes. Each is cast then with its own bounds and its own fresh census. This ticket writes nothing of theirs.

out: every record of truth (nothing renames before the quiet window)
every reader in cairn and CairnCommons

measured.saw: 3,070 *.json records under CairnCommons/{tickets,decisions,slates,ideas,questions,adjudications}; 3,079 on a re-measure an hour later (troubles/ is no longer in the commons)
measured.how: find tickets troubles decisions slates ideas questions adjudications -name '*.json' | wc -l in CairnCommons, akienasus

measured.saw: 971 tracked state/history/intention+why/validation *.json files in cairn; 975 on the re-measure
measured.how: git ls-files | grep -cE '(^|/)(state|history|intention\+why)\.json$|/validations/[^/]*\.json$' in cairn, akienasus

measured.saw: 127 reader files, 322 sites reading records by their .json name
measured.how: the reader census taken at this ticket's first cast, recorded in its falsifier clause 4 (old shape); stale, so each reader-group child re-measures its own
